name: Yamaha XT660Z Tenere
intro: Yamaha's 660 single adventure bike. Mostly sold outside the US, so many here are imports.

A: Many US XT660Zs are imports. Make sure the title and VIN paperwork match before you put money in.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
